title: 第2884章 说出真相第2883章 可怕的时间日晷
lines: 或者可以说，自江尘出现之后所做的这些事，就没有一件是不让人震惊的。
以三脉龙族族长多年的见识，都无法利用多年的见识，对这些事情解释万一。
只能说世界之大无奇不有，他们还是太年轻了。
“如今你也有了时间日晷，我们的底蕴可就大得多了。”
“接下来也该前往各大圣地，收服各大圣地内的仙品异种元素了吧？”
敖太虚对江尘问道。
江尘立刻笑道：“正有此意。”
“此前所做的掩盖应该还能维持几日，这几日时间应该足够我收服各大圣地的异种元素了。”
听闻此言，敖太虚点了点头，随后又问道：“对了，之前一直没有问你，不知你叫什么名字？”
“将你带回这里这么久，还不知道你的姓名，是我这个做长辈的错。”
敖太虚脸上带着一抹尴尬，作为空间龙族族长，好不容易将流落在沧玄大陆的同族小辈带了回来，过去这么久，却连人家的名字都没有问，实在不应该。
敖光隙与敖金霄两位族长也颇有些尴尬。
他们还将江尘当成了三脉龙族重归大陆的希望的，结果连人家的名字都不知道。
这事儿做的着实是差了。
他们却没注意到狗兔子和净尘瞳孔一缩，竟是齐齐向后退了一步。
坏了，这三位居然真问起此事了，这下瞒不住了。
江尘倒是没有像他们一样表现得十分心虚的样子。
他看着三位族长，脸上忽而染上了几分歉意，此刻终于对这三位说了实话。
“敖族长，这件事其实是我的错。”
江尘此时没有再称其为伯父，而是以族长相称。
“其实我并非空间龙族子弟，而是雷泽圣地弟子，我也是之前跟你们说过的那个故事的主角，江尘！”
事情到了今日这一地步，已经没有必要再隐瞒下去了。
原本此事就是迟早要让这几位知道的，眼下既然三人问起了名字的事儿，倒不如顺势解释一番。
敖太虚等三位龙族族长显然没想到江尘会这样说。
一时间不由得心神大震，瞪大双眼盯着江尘。
“你，你说什么，你不是空间龙族的族人？可你……”
最不敢相信这件事的，无疑是敖太虚了。
一直以来他都将江尘当成了他们空间龙族的天命之子，对于这位空间龙族的后辈寄予了无限的厚望。
结果没想到对方居然并非龙族，也并非空间龙族子弟！
这是在跟他开玩笑吗？
“敖族长，我知道你的意思，你是想说，既然我是人族，却又为何能够维持龙族的形态吧？”
江尘看向敖太虚，对于敖太虚，他是最感到抱歉的。
此时他还维持着空间龙族的半龙人形态，全身都遍布银色龙鳞，看起来与空间龙族的子弟完全相同。
这种情况下，别说是敖太虚了，就是自己的亲爹娘来了，看到自己以后也不会承认他是人族。
而对于自己的这项能力，一直以来，江尘都是对外掩盖着的，从不会对外人说起。
但如今自己的实力早已达到了这个世界的顶峰，哪怕是三位龙族族长，也没有必要再向他们隐瞒。
当下为了解释这一切，江尘在三位族长震惊的目光下，摇身一变，浑身的龙鳞竟然从银色变成了金色，随后又变成黄色，之后又不断变换为八脉龙族的特征。
content_en:
In other words, none of the things Jiang Chen has done since he appeared are not shocking.
Even the patriarch of the Three Meridians Dragon Clan cannot use his years of experience to explain these things.
It can only be said that the world is full of wonders, but they are still too young.
"Now that you also have a time dial, our foundation is much greater."
"Next, it's time to go to the major holy places and conquer the immortal and alien elements in the major holy places, right?"
Ao Taixu asked Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen immediately smiled and said, "That's exactly what I meant."
"The cover-up I made before should be able to last for a few days. These few days should be enough for me to conquer the alien elements in the major holy places."
Hearing this, Ao Taixu nodded, and then asked: "By the way, I haven't asked you before, what is your name?"
"It's my fault as an elder that I brought you here for so long and still don't know your name."
There was a trace of embarrassment on Ao Taixu's face. As the leader of the Space Dragon Clan, he finally brought back his younger generation who had been living in Cangxuan Continent. It had been so long, but he didn't even ask his name. It really shouldn't have happened.
The two clan leaders, Ao Guangxi and Ao Jinxiao, were also quite embarrassed.
They also regarded Jiang Chen as the hope of the Three-line Dragon Clan to return to the mainland, but in the end they didn't even know his name.
This was really poorly done.
They didn't notice that Gou Tu and Jing Chen's pupils shrank, and they all took a step back.
Damn it, these three people actually asked about it, now they couldn't hide it anymore.
Jiang Chen didn't look as guilty as they did.
He looked at the three clan leaders, his face suddenly stained with a hint of apology, and at this moment he finally told the truth to these three.
"Clan Chief Ao, this matter is actually my fault."
Jiang Chen no longer called him uncle at this time, but instead addressed him as clan leader.
"Actually, I am not a disciple of the Space Dragon Clan, but a disciple of the Lei Ze Holy Land. I am also the protagonist of the story I told you before, Jiang Chen!"
Now that things have reached this point, there is no need to hide it any longer.
Originally, this matter was going to be known to these people sooner or later. Now that the three of them asked about the name, it would be better to explain it.
Ao Taixu and the other three Dragon Clan clan leaders obviously did not expect Jiang Chen to say this.
For a moment, I couldn't help but feel shocked, staring at Jiang Chen with wide eyes.
"You, what are you saying, you are not a member of the Space Dragon Clan? But you..."
The person who couldn't believe this the most was undoubtedly Ao Taixu.
He has always regarded Jiang Chen as the destined son of their Space Dragon Clan, and has placed infinite high hopes on this youngster of the Space Dragon Clan.
As a result, I didn't expect that the other party was not a dragon, nor was he a descendant of the space dragon!
Is this a joke on him?
"Clan Chief Ao, I know what you mean. You want to say, since I am a human, why can I maintain the form of a dragon?"
Jiang Chen looked at Ao Taixu. He was the most sorry for Ao Taixu.
At this time, he still maintained the half-dragon form of the Space Dragon Clan. His whole body was covered with silver dragon scales, and he looked exactly like the children of the Space Dragon Clan.
In this case, let alone Ao Taixu, even if his biological parents came, they would not recognize him as a human after seeing him.
As for his ability, Jiang Chen has always concealed it from the outside world and never mentioned it to outsiders.
But now that his strength has reached the pinnacle of this world, there is no need to hide it from even the three dragon clan leaders.
In order to explain all this, Jiang Chen transformed under the shocked gazes of the three clan leaders. The dragon scales all over his body turned from silver to gold, then to yellow, and then continued to transform into the characteristics of the Eight Veins Dragon Clan.
